title: Road-safety demonstrations commemorating traffic-death victims (May 21 national action)
location: Multiple locations; sources name Sofia, Shumen, Varna, Etropole, Kazanlak, Samokov, Bratanitsa and Chirpan; Svobodna Evropa describes ten cities
scope: Reported as coordinated/national day of demonstrations; whether one national event or separate city actions and total simultaneous attendance unresolved
organizer: Parents/relatives of people killed in traffic crashes, as described by Svobodna Evropa; exact national organization unresolved
participants_original: Svobodna Evropa says several dozen at one Sofia crossing and protests in ten cities; BNR names multiple cities but gives no count.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established: only explicit size is several dozen at a Sofia site; city totals and simultaneous aggregate are unquantified.

occurrence.summary: Two contemporaneous reports describe executed May21 protests; one says they blocked intersections in ten cities and BNR names multiple locations.

location.summary: Reports describe Sofia and several named cities; not an exhaustive inventory.

demands.summary: Protesters sought tougher legal penalties, enforcement and safer infrastructure, directed to Bulgarian legislative/executive policy.

participants.summary: No total; one local description says several dozen. >=50 unresolved.

state_response.summary: State response not established; all unknown.

notes: Two body requests lacked saved pre-request assessments due the documented writer error; post-request record does not cure it. Earlier nightly Sofia actions after May8 may be related but onset and threshold are unresolved.
open_questions: Were same-day cities one national event or distinct local actions?
How did May21 relate to nightly Sofia actions after May8?

title: May Day union actions for wages, working conditions and strike rights
location: Sofia; BNT reports KNSB action at Orlov Most and a separate Podkrepa march/concert; exact crowd locations/counts not fully specified
scope: Multiple reported union actions in Sofia on Labor Day; do not assume one merged gathering or national attendance
organizer: Confederation of Independent Trade Unions in Bulgaria (KNSB) and Confederation of Labour Podkrepa, as separately described by BNT
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance figure or clearly supported qualitative threshold in the body; pending.

occurrence.summary: BNT reports the May1 actions were held and describes a half-hour Orlov Most blockade and a union procession.

location.summary: Orlov Most blockade and Sofia procession/concert are reported.

demands.summary: Higher incomes, better working conditions and a law guaranteeing right to strike; law/budget-related demands address domestic public policy.

protester_violence.summary: No violence evidence or explicit absence; unknown.

notes: Executed public actions verified, but attendance is not reported. Article also links a BSP May Day rally; that appears to be a separate gathering and its eligibility is not determined.
open_questions: Did each union action involve >=50 people?
Were the KNSB blockade and Podkrepa march coordinated or separate episodes?
Did BSP's separate May Day rally make any state-policy demand or meet threshold?

title: Sofia protest demanding President Rumen Radev's resignation
participants_original: Thousands, as reported by The Sofia Globe; no exact figure
threshold_50_evidence: Contemporaneous body directly describes thousands attending, clearly above 50.

occurrence.summary: The article reports thousands gathered in Sofia on May30.

start_date.summary: Article explicitly dates the protest to the evening of May30, 2023.

location.summary: People gathered outside the Presidency building in Sofia.

demands.summary: Chants demanded Radev's resignation and signs criticized his stance on Russia's war; demand directed at a Bulgarian officeholder/policy.

participants.summary: Source says thousands; no numeric interval inferred.

organizer.summary: Organizer not identified in inspected report.

state_response.summary: Police presence outside the Presidency described, but no response action established; all response fields unknown.

notes: One contemporaneous report supports executed public gathering, >50 scale, domestic politician resignation demand and precise onset. Independent review still pending; no official status is assigned.
open_questions: What was the event's end time/date?
Were any state response actions documented?
Was this separate from later June protests against Radev or part of a continuous series?
